correctness.rationale: Exact absorbing coordinate-reset dynamics gives J=||x||_2^2+beta||x||_inf^2. For every valid max-of-m quadratic upper envelope, basis diagonal values plus pigeonhole and Rademacher sign averaging force ratio >=(1+beta)/(1+beta/r), even with arbitrary off-diagonal entries. Balanced partition pieces attain equality and satisfy every explicit co-complete graph Bellman LMI because rho^2(1+beta)=beta. The upper envelope ratio uses s<=min(1,r t) and is maximized at t=1/r. All integer n,m and 0<rho<1 are proved analytically; the 132 rational, 71,991 assignment and off-diagonal sign checks corroborate, not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The precise number of quadratic pieces is the intrinsic graph design budget in path-complete performance certification. The result gives a fully sharp finite n,m,rho cost-versus-accuracy frontier, integer plateaus, a high-persistence lower bound that can grow with n/m, and an LMI-feasible graph attaining the optimum. This is a motivated structural graph-certificate benchmark, not a mere numerical table or renaming of a general certificate theorem; it claims no benefit for arbitrary dynamics or practical runtimes.
